sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: President Trump's trade war against China has so far proven much harder to win than his administration ever let on.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统对华发起的贸易战，迄今为止证明比其政府所宣称的要难打得多。

sentences.en: And it's only getting worse as China undertakes its most aggressive act of retaliation to date.
sentences.zh: 而且随着中国采取迄今为止最具侵略性的报复行动，情况只会变得更糟。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Keith Bradshaw on a potential turning point in the standoff as President Trump meets this week with Chinese leader Xi Jinping
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事基思·布拉德肖将探讨这场僵局的潜在转折点，本周特朗普总统将与中国领导人习近平会晤，

sentences.en: in what will be their first talks since the trade war began.
sentences.zh: 这将是自贸易战开始以来的首次会谈。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月29日，星期三。

sentences.en: Keith, I think a lot of us, frankly, started to feel as though this trade war may have finally died down.
sentences.zh: 基思，坦率地说，我们很多人开始觉得这场贸易战可能终于平息了。

sentences.en: I think we were lulled perhaps into a false sense of calm when there wasn't that much news on this for months.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可能被几个月来相对平静的局势所误导，产生了一种虚假的安宁感。

sentences.en: But then, all of a sudden, things seemed to heat back up again.
sentences.zh: 但随后，局势突然又开始升温。

sentences.en: So, give us a sense of the state of the relationship right now.
sentences.zh: 那么，请给我们介绍一下目前双方关系的状况。

sentences.en: The relationship is at one of its tensest moments in years.
sentences.zh: 两国关系正处于多年来最紧张的时刻之一。

sentences.en: Both sides have threatened measures bordering on economic warfare against each other.
sentences.zh: 双方都威胁要采取近乎经济战的措施来对付对方。

sentences.en: There's an urgency to resolving these issues at the meeting on Thursday in South Korea between the two countries' top leaders.
sentences.zh: 周四在韩国举行的两国最高领导人会议上，解决这些问题显得尤为紧迫。

sentences.en: Here in Beijing, everyone is watching to see can they reach some kind of a deal that pulls both countries back from the brink.
sentences.zh: 在北京，每个人都在关注他们能否达成某种协议，将两国从悬崖边缘拉回来。

sentences.en: And what are the main sticking points right now in these negotiations?
sentences.zh: 目前这些谈判的主要症结是什么？

sentences.en: Like, what do we expect to come up in that meeting?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们预计会议会讨论什么？

sentences.en: The United States wants China to start buying soybeans again.
sentences.zh: 美国希望中国重新开始购买大豆。

sentences.en: China has a boycott against American soybeans right now because of its unhappiness with American policies.
sentences.zh: 由于对美国政策不满，中国目前对美国大豆实施了抵制。

sentences.en: The United States wants China to stop shipping the chemicals that are used in Mexico and Latin America to make fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 美国希望中国停止向墨西哥和拉丁美洲运送用于制造芬太尼的化学品。

sentences.en: China wants the United States to allow it to buy any kinds of semiconductors it wants, including some of the most advanced semiconductors
sentences.zh: 中国希望美国允许其购买任何种类的半导体，包括一些最先进的半导体，

sentences.en: used in artificial intelligence and high-performance military systeMs.
sentences.zh: 这些半导体用于人工智能和高性能军事系统。

sentences.en: And China in particular wants America to distance itself from Taiwan, although America depends enormously on Taiwan for semiconductors.
sentences.zh: 中国尤其希望美国与台湾保持距离，尽管美国在半导体方面极度依赖台湾。

sentences.en: But hanging over all of these issues is a big debate over rare earth metals.
sentences.zh: 但笼罩在所有这些问题之上的是关于稀土金属的重大争论。

sentences.en: China is threatening to cut off much of the world's supply, and it's saying that it will block any effort outside of China
sentences.zh: 中国威胁要切断全球大部分供应，并表示将阻止中国境外任何试图

sentences.en: to manufacture rare earths and rare earth magnets in competition with China.
sentences.zh: 与中国竞争生产稀土和稀土磁铁的努力。

sentences.en: Can you just unpack what exactly China did?
sentences.zh: 你能具体解读一下中国到底做了什么吗？

sentences.en: Because this was something that I think a lot of people were talking about as a major escalation.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为很多人都在谈论这是一个重大的升级。

sentences.en: There were new restrictions, right, on these rare earth minerals.
sentences.zh: 对这些稀土矿产有了新的限制，对吧？

sentences.en: These are critically important to, you know, everything from missiles to cars.
sentences.zh: 这些东西对从导弹到汽车的方方面面都至关重要。

sentences.en: We need them.
sentences.zh: 我们需要它们。

sentences.en: And China was saying you can't have them.
sentences.zh: 而中国说你们不能拥有它们。

sentences.en: What exactly happened?
sentences.zh: 到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Rare earths are very important these days.
sentences.zh: 稀土如今非常重要。

sentences.en: They are used all over the economy.
sentences.zh: 它们在整个经济中被广泛使用。

sentences.en: Whether it's cars, computer chips, fighter jets, missiles,
sentences.zh: 无论是汽车、电脑芯片、战斗机还是导弹，

sentences.en: China controls the materials, rare earth metals, for making them anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 中国控制着制造这些产品所需的稀土金属材料，无论是在世界何处。

sentences.en: And it has put already in April some export controls on supplying those materials.
sentences.zh: 而且中国已经在四月份对这些材料的供应实施了一些出口管制。

sentences.en: And on October 9th, China said, we're going to put a lot more restrictions on these.
sentences.zh: 10月9日，中国表示，我们将对这些产品实施更多限制。

sentences.en: China is expanding its restrictions on rare earth exports.
sentences.zh: 中国正在扩大对稀土出口的限制。

sentences.en: The new rules do three things.
sentences.zh: 新规定做了三件事。

sentences.en: One, they prevent the West from being able to build its own mines and refineries and magnet factories, or at least they make it much more difficult for the West to do that.
sentences.zh: 第一，它们阻止西方建立自己的矿山、精炼厂和磁铁工厂，或者至少让西方这样做变得更加困难。

sentences.en: So, no more using any Chinese patents without permission.
sentences.zh: 所以，未经许可不得再使用任何中国专利。

sentences.en: No more buying equipment from China to do any of this.
sentences.zh: 不得再从中国购买设备来做这些事。

sentences.en: And China makes almost all the equipment for mining and refining rare earths or making magnets.
sentences.zh: 而中国制造了几乎所有用于开采、提炼稀土或制造磁铁的设备。

sentences.en: Second, the new rules put restrictions on what you are allowed to move across any country's borders if it has Chinese magnets and rare earths inside it.
sentences.zh: 第二，新规定限制了如果产品内部含有中国磁铁和稀土，你被允许将其跨越任何国家边界运输的范围。

sentences.en: And third, China is saying for the first time that it's going to restrict even more kinds of rare earths than it did the first time around last April.
sentences.zh: 第三，中国首次表示，它将比去年四月第一次时限制更多种类的稀土。

sentences.en: And so this will affect even more military production.
sentences.zh: 因此，这将影响更多的军事生产。

sentences.en: For example, making it hard for Europe to build weapon systems for Ukraine or for Europe to protect itself against Russia.
sentences.zh: 例如，使欧洲难以制造用于乌克兰的武器系统，或难以保护自己免受俄罗斯的威胁。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump just announced a 100% add-on tariff to China for their export controls on rare earths.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生刚刚宣布对中国因其稀土出口管制而加征100%的关税。

sentences.en: And look at this sell-off.
sentences.zh: 看看这次抛售。

sentences.en: Tonight, the stock market plunging nearly 900 points at the close.
sentences.zh: 今晚，股市收盘时暴跌近900点。

sentences.en: This is China versus the world.
sentences.zh: 这是中国与世界的对抗。

sentences.en: They have pointed a bazooka at the supply chains and the industrial base of the entire free world.
sentences.zh: 他们把火箭筒对准了整个自由世界的供应链和工业基础。

sentences.en: And that's why Treasury Secretary Scott Besant said that these new rules are a bazooka aimed at the entire world's supply chains.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么财政部长斯科特·贝森特说，这些新规定是瞄准全世界供应链的火箭筒。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're not going to have it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们绝不会接受。

sentences.en: I have to say, for me, this is like a control freak's approach to trade restrictions.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，对我而言，这就像是一个控制狂对待贸易限制的方式。

sentences.en: Is this normal?
sentences.zh: 这正常吗？

sentences.en: Like, do countries typically make their trade rules this specific, this in-depth, so as to control every aspect of how a product is used?
sentences.zh: 各国通常会把贸易规则制定得如此具体、如此深入，以至于要控制产品使用方式的每一个方面吗？

sentences.en: The United States has done this with the fastest semiconductors.
sentences.zh: 美国在最先进的半导体上就是这样做的。

sentences.en: So about the top 3% to 5% of the world's semiconductors do have these very restrictive rules
sentences.zh: 所以全球约3%到5%的最顶尖半导体确实受到这些非常严格的规定限制，

sentences.en: from the United States that do track what downstream products they are later built into.
sentences.zh: 这些规定来自美国，确实追踪了它们后续被安装在哪些下游产品中。

sentences.en: What is new and different about China's rules is that China is putting the restrictions on a raw material
sentences.zh: 中国规则的新颖和不同之处在于，中国将限制施加在原材料上，

sentences.en: and then saying that products that are later manufactured from that raw material are also restricted.
sentences.zh: 然后声称由该原材料后续制造的产品也受到限制。

sentences.en: So, in a way, this is a combination of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，这是美国

sentences.en: rules on semiconductors combined with the Arab oil embargo in 1973 against the United States and its allies, which was aimed at halting American support for Israel at the time.
sentences.zh: 半导体规则与1973年阿拉伯国家对美国及其盟友实施石油禁运的结合，当时旨在阻止美国支持以色列。

sentences.en: So it is both a high-tech restriction and, in China's case, it is now also a raw material restriction, both at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所以这既是高科技限制，就中国而言，现在也是原材料限制，两者同时进行。

sentences.en: Can I ask, Keith, do you agree with Besson's assessment that this is China pulling out a bazooka?
sentences.zh: 我可以问一下吗，基思，你同意贝森特的评估，即这是中国拿出了火箭筒吗？

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我确实同意。

sentences.en: This is China trying to make sure that it controls global commerce and can turn on and off the taps,
sentences.zh: 这是中国试图确保它控制全球商业，并能随时开关水龙头，

sentences.en: not just for goods leaving China, but for goods moving across Europe, across North America, across South Asia, you name it.
sentences.zh: 不仅是针对离开中国的货物，还包括在欧洲、北美、南亚等地流动的货物，随便你怎么说。

sentences.en: This is seeking a new global level of comprehensive control out of Beijing by the Ministry of Commerce.
sentences.zh: 这是商务部试图从北京出发，寻求一种新的全球综合控制水平。

sentences.en: And how should we interpret the fact that China's decided to do this now?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何解读中国决定现在这样做的事实？

sentences.en: Is that a sign that the Chinese government has kind of reached a point of no return in these negotiations,
sentences.zh: 这是否表明中国政府在这些谈判中已经到了没有退路的地步，

sentences.en: that they're using what sounds like one of their biggest points of leverage?
sentences.zh: 他们正在使用听起来是他们最大的筹码之一？

sentences.en: China has concluded that it benefits from taking very strong stands towards Trump and also towards Europe.
sentences.zh: 中国已经得出结论，对特朗普以及欧洲采取非常强硬的立场是有利的。

sentences.en: This is a China that is not allowing itself to be pushed around.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不再允许自己被随意摆布的中国。

sentences.en: We've now seen top Chinese leaders line up with the leaders of Russia and North Korea at military parades twice in six weeks in Beijing and then in Pyongyang.
sentences.zh: 我们现在已经看到中国高层领导人在六周内两次在北京和平壤的阅兵式上与俄罗斯和朝鲜领导人并肩站在一起。

sentences.en: And so China has really in some ways embarked on a new geopolitical stance and a new economic stance of standing tough against the West to protect China's strategic interests.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国在某种程度上确实开启了一种新的地缘政治立场和新的经济立场，即对西方采取强硬态度以保护中国的战略利益。

sentences.en: And for the rest of us, for the rest of the world, what are the implications?
sentences.zh: 对于我们其他人，对于世界其他地区，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: For the rest of the world, this could be extremely damaging.
sentences.zh: 对于世界其他地区，这可能具有极大的破坏性。

sentences.en: Any country with an advanced manufacturing sector has to be really worried about this.
sentences.zh: 任何拥有先进制造业的国家都必须对此感到非常担忧。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Let's talk about what you mean, Keith, when you said this could be extremely damaging.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈你所说的“可能具有极大的破坏性”是什么意思，基思。

sentences.en: Spell out for me what kind of damage we'd be looking at in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 给我详细说明一下，在美国，我们将会面临什么样的损害，

sentences.en: with these restrictions.
sentences.zh: 如果这些限制实施的话。

sentences.en: There is the immediate damage of American companies continuing to have trouble getting enough rare earth magnets just to make their day-to-day products.
sentences.zh: 直接的损害是美国公司继续难以获得足够的稀土磁铁来制造日常产品。

sentences.en: Detroit has been struggling to get enough brake motors, steering motors, power seat motors, all these different systems that require rare earth magnets.
sentences.zh: 底特律一直在努力获取足够的制动电机、转向电机、电动座椅电机，所有这些不同的系统都需要稀土磁铁。

sentences.en: And as more of these Chinese regulations from October 9th take effect, it will become even harder for American companies, for example,
sentences.zh: 随着10月9日的更多中国法规生效，美国公司将变得更加困难，例如，

sentences.en: even to move parts across the border from Mexico or across the border from Canada.
sentences.zh: 甚至难以将零部件从墨西哥或加拿大边境运送过来。

sentences.en: What about the national security implications of this?
sentences.zh: 那国家安全方面的影响呢？

sentences.en: Because you've told us rare earths go into missiles, go into a ton of military equipment.
sentences.zh: 因为你告诉过我们稀土用于导弹，用于大量的军事装备。

sentences.en: The West is already having trouble in slowing down production of some military items because of the shortage of rare earths.
sentences.zh: 由于稀土短缺，西方已经在减缓某些军事装备的生产方面遇到困难。

sentences.en: The West failed to stockpile these rare earths in advance.
sentences.zh: 西方未能提前储备这些稀土。

sentences.en: And so the military contractors trying to supply Ukraine or trying to rebuild inventories in the West are really having trouble procuring the magnets they need.
sentences.zh: 因此，试图供应乌克兰或试图重建西方库存的军事承包商在采购所需的磁铁方面确实遇到了困难。

sentences.en: So this is a big win for Russia because the West really needs these rare earths to continue supplying military equipment to Ukraine to defend itself.
sentences.zh: 所以这对俄罗斯来说是一个巨大的胜利，因为西方确实需要这些稀土来继续向乌克兰提供军事装备以进行自卫。

sentences.en: And now that supply has been cut off cold by China.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这一供应已被中国彻底切断。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: This clearly has pretty big consequences for Europe, which is honestly kind of surprising.
sentences.zh: 这显然对欧洲产生了相当大的影响，老实说这有点令人惊讶。

sentences.en: I thought this was a U.S.-China trade war.
sentences.zh: 我以为这是一场美中贸易战。

sentences.en: Why is China now putting the screws to Europe?
sentences.zh: 为什么中国现在要给欧洲施加压力？

sentences.en: China has a whole separate dispute going with Europe over cars.
sentences.zh: 中国与欧洲在汽车问题上有一场完全独立的争端。

sentences.en: The European Union became very concerned last year that China had subsidized the development of electric cars and was going to flood the European market with electric cars.
sentences.zh: 欧盟去年非常担心中国补贴电动汽车的发展，并打算用电动汽车淹没欧洲市场。

sentences.en: And so the European Union put tariffs in place and there was a big loophole left in these tariffs,
sentences.zh: 因此，欧盟实施了关税，但在这些关税中留下了一个巨大的漏洞，

sentences.en: which is that if you put a tiny gasoline engine in along with a great big electric system in these cars, then you don't pay any tariffs at all.
sentences.zh: 那就是如果你在这些车里安装一个微型汽油发动机，再加上一个巨大的电力系统，那么你根本不需要支付任何关税。

sentences.en: And so China has been flooding the European market, particularly this year, with exactly that category of highly capable electric cars with a tiny gasoline engine included,
sentences.zh: 所以中国今年一直在向欧洲市场大量出口这种完全符合条件的、带有微型汽油发动机的高性能电动汽车，

sentences.en: and they don't face any extra tariff.
sentences.zh: 而且它们不需要面临任何额外关税。

sentences.en: China does not want Europe to raise tariffs.
sentences.zh: 中国不希望欧洲提高关税。

sentences.en: It does not want Europe to close the hybrid loophole.
sentences.zh: 它不希望欧洲堵住混合动力车的漏洞。

sentences.en: So China is putting a lot of pressure on Europe.
sentences.zh: 所以中国正在给欧洲施加很大压力。

sentences.en: And then finally, China has leaned towards Russia on the Ukraine issue.
sentences.zh: 最后，中国在乌克兰问题上倾向于俄罗斯。

sentences.en: China wants Europe to distance itself from the United States in NATO.
sentences.zh: 中国希望欧洲在北约问题上与美国保持距离。

sentences.en: So China has a lot of incentives to be very tough with Europe and has been very tough with Europe this year.
sentences.zh: 所以中国有很多动机对欧洲非常强硬，而且今年对欧洲一直非常强硬。

sentences.en: Listening to you, Keith, I have to say it does seem as though China has the ability to inflict just enormous pain with this.
sentences.zh: 听了你的话，基思，我不得不说，中国似乎确实有能力用这种方式造成巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: If China is willing to go this far in the trade war, it does seem fair to say that they have the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 如果中国愿意在贸易战中走这么远，说他们占据上风似乎是公平的。

sentences.en: Am I wrong about that?
sentences.zh: 我这么说错了吗？

sentences.en: Short term, China does have a very strong position.
sentences.zh: 短期内，中国确实处于非常有利的地位。

sentences.en: But there are real long-term dangers to the Chinese economy in pursuing this strategy.
sentences.zh: 但采取这种策略对中国经济存在真正的长期危险。

sentences.en: So many multinational companies have come to rely on China for part or all of their supplies of many components, many products that you see in stores all over the United States.
sentences.zh: 如此多的跨国公司已经开始依赖中国来供应部分或全部的零部件，以及你在美国各地的商店里看到的许多产品。

sentences.en: And as China shows that it's willing practically overnight to halt these supplies, China is damaging its reputation as a reliable supplier.
sentences.zh: 随着中国表现出几乎在一夜之间就愿意停止这些供应，中国正在损害其作为可靠供应商的声誉。

sentences.en: European and American companies are frantically searching for ways to buy more from Southeast Asia, from India, and from elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 欧洲和美国的公司正疯狂地寻找从东南亚、印度和其他地方购买更多产品的方法。

sentences.en: So there is a long-term interest in China in not taking this too far.
sentences.zh: 所以中国在长期利益上不应该走得太远。

sentences.en: In fact, it's already gone far enough that they are worried in China that they may be losing their appeal as a destination for foreign investment.
sentences.zh: 事实上，情况已经发展到中国担心他们可能会失去作为外国投资目的地的吸引力。

sentences.en: Who wants to build another factory in China if you're not going to be able to send the goods from that factory out of China?
sentences.zh: 如果你不能把工厂里的货物运出中国，谁还想在中国建另一家工厂呢？

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: It's like China, in trying to show the world, look, you really can't live without us.
sentences.zh: 这就像中国试图向世界展示：看，你们真的离不开我们。

sentences.en: You can't live without our rare earths.
sentences.zh: 你们离不开我们的稀土。

sentences.en: Beijing may actually be spurring the world to look for ways to live without it, to find a way to reduce that reliance on China for just about everything.
sentences.zh: 北京实际上可能正在促使世界寻找离开它也能生存的方法，找到一种减少对中国几乎所有东西依赖的方法。

sentences.en: That is exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: China is not backing down in any way.
sentences.zh: 中国绝不会退缩。

sentences.en: China is all in on restricting rare earths.
sentences.zh: 中国全力以赴限制稀土。

sentences.en: That's a risky position to be in when you're a country like China that lives on exports, even as the domestic economy is a mess.
sentences.zh: 对于像中国这样一个依赖出口的国家来说，这是一个危险的立场，即使国内经济一团糟。

sentences.en: So China may have overplayed its hand.
sentences.zh: 所以中国可能用力过猛了。

sentences.en: But it seems equally possible, plausible even, that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但同样可能，甚至可以说同样合理的是，美国

sentences.en: actually overplayed its hand because it's forced China into this point of no return where now it's pulling out the big guns,
sentences.zh: 实际上是操之过急了，因为它迫使中国走到了无法回头的地步，现在中国正祭出杀手锏，

sentences.en: where now it's using its biggest point of leverage and forcing everyone into a corner.
sentences.zh: 现在中国正在利用其最大的筹码，将所有人逼入绝境。

sentences.en: It's possible the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国有可能

sentences.en: has overplayed its hand, but the U.S.
sentences.zh: 操之过急了，但美国

sentences.en: is in a very difficult position because China has enormous overcapacity of factories.
sentences.zh: 处境非常艰难，因为中国工厂的产能过剩极其严重。

sentences.en: And just last Thursday, we had a pivotal moment.
sentences.zh: 就在上周四，我们经历了一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: The central committee of the entire Communist Party said, we're going to double down on manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 整个共产党中央委员会表示，我们要加倍投入制造业。

sentences.en: We want to be the country that makes everything.
sentences.zh: 我们想成为制造一切的国家。

sentences.en: And that is a direct challenge to the United States and Europe, which still have some manufacturing sectors, and to Japan and to South Korea.
sentences.zh: 这对美国和欧洲——它们仍保留着一些制造业部门——以及日本和韩国构成了直接挑战。

sentences.en: This emphasis on making practically all kinds of advanced technology is really a worry.
sentences.zh: 这种对制造几乎所有先进技术的强调确实令人担忧。

sentences.en: And so the United States is on the spot now.
sentences.zh: 所以美国现在处于风口浪尖。

sentences.en: Does it take a short-term strategy of accepting a deal that gets it back to where it was at the start of the year,
sentences.zh: 它是采取短期策略，接受一项能让局势回到年初水平的协议，

sentences.en: but risks further deterioration of what's left of the American manufacturing sector?
sentences.zh: 但冒着美国制造业残余部分进一步恶化的风险？

sentences.en: Or does it continue to have a confrontation, but that could be very painful?
sentences.zh: 还是继续对抗，但这可能会非常痛苦？

sentences.en: So are you saying it's possible that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，美国有可能

sentences.en: overplayed its hand, but it had no other option?
sentences.zh: 操之过急，但它别无选择？

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: was not in a good position to begin with, and the Biden administration had struggled with the same issue.
sentences.zh: 起初的处境并不好，拜登政府也曾为同样的问题苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: The Biden strategy was to proceed cautiously and avoid an outright confrontation, unlike Trump.
sentences.zh: 与特朗普不同，拜登的策略是谨慎行事，避免直接对抗。

sentences.en: But the Biden administration also had the weakness of not really slowing down China's remarkable race towards dominance of an extremely wide range of manufacturing industries.
sentences.zh: 但拜登政府的弱点在于，并没有真正放慢中国在极其广泛的制造业领域追求主导地位的惊人步伐。

sentences.en: And so the Trump administration felt a need to go considerably farther, and that has now triggered an outsized response from Beijing.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普政府感到有必要走得更远，而这现在引发了北京方面强烈的反击。

sentences.en: — You're sort of saying it's like you're damned if you do, you're damned if you don't.
sentences.zh: ——你这话的意思是，进退两难。

sentences.en: If you don't go hard enough to try to combat China's dominance in manufacturing, nothing actually gets done about it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不采取强硬手段来对抗中国在制造业的主导地位，实际上就什么也做不成。

sentences.en: But if you do go too hard, you risk eliciting this kind of really potentially damaging retaliation.
sentences.zh: 但如果你做得太绝，就有可能招致这种极具破坏性的报复。

sentences.en: That's exactly right, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: — But has all this poking of the bear that the Trump administration's done actually done anything to slow China's progression toward the most dominant superpower manufacturing country that we've ever seen?
sentences.zh: ——但是，特朗普政府对中国的一系列挑衅，真的有起到任何减缓中国向我们所见过的最强制造业超级大国迈进的作用吗？

sentences.en: — Yes.
sentences.zh: ——是的。

sentences.en: The Trump administration tariffs have resulted in a significant drop in Chinese exports to the United States, more than 20 percent this year compared to last year.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府的关税导致中国对美出口大幅下降，今年比去年下降了超过20%。

sentences.en: On the other hand, China has been ramping up exports to other countries, such as Vietnam,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，中国一直在增加对越南等其他国家的出口，

sentences.en: and you get estimates that as much as 85 percent of China's exports to Vietnam then end up in the United States.
sentences.zh: 据估计，中国对越南出口的产品中，有多达85%最终进入了美国。

sentences.en: — So Chinese exporters have been very nimble in finding alternative routes through countries like Vietnam and Mexico to still reach the U.S.
sentences.zh: ——所以中国出口商非常灵活，通过越南和墨西哥等国家寻找替代路线，以继续进入美国

sentences.en: market.
sentences.zh: 市场。

sentences.en: But the Trump administration felt it needed to do something because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普政府认为它必须采取行动，因为美国

sentences.en: industrial base has been rapidly hollowing out.
sentences.zh: 工业基础一直在迅速空心化。

sentences.en: And without a strong manufacturing sector, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果没有强大的制造业，美国

sentences.en: cannot remain a strong country with a strong conventional military that can protect not only the United States but other democracies around the world.
sentences.zh: 就无法保持为一个拥有强大常规军事力量的强国，从而保护美国自身以及世界各地的其他民主国家。

sentences.en: — The situation you've described is one where the stakes are just incredibly high for both sides.
sentences.zh: ——你所描述的情况是双方都面临着极高的风险。

sentences.en: So at this meeting between Trump and Xi this week, what should we expect to see?
sentences.zh: 那么在本周特朗普与习近平的会晤中，我们应该期待看到什么？

sentences.en: Do you expect a dramatic announcement or just the continuation of what we've seen before, which is incremental agreements, temporary pauses, etc.?
sentences.zh: 你预计会有重大的声明，还是仅仅延续我们之前所见到的，即渐进式的协议、暂时的停火等等？

sentences.en: — I expect a dramatic announcement of temporary agreements and incremental changes.
sentences.zh: ——我预计会有关于临时协议和渐进式变革的重大声明。

sentences.en: I think that what we will see is a postponement, for example, of China's rare earth restrictions, but not a repeal of them.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们将看到的是，例如，中国稀土限制措施的推迟，但不会是废除。

sentences.en: I think we are likely to see some Chinese purchases of American soybeans, but not on a scale that they previously were.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们很可能会看到中国购买一些美国大豆，但规模不会像以前那么大。

sentences.en: One other aspect that we'll probably see is some kind of Chinese promise to limit exports of chemicals used in making fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会看到的另一个方面是，中国承诺限制用于制造芬太尼的化学品的出口。

sentences.en: And then we may see a promise to get together and have a more in-depth conversation in China next February.
sentences.zh: 然后我们可能会看到一个承诺，即明年二月在中国进行更深入的对话。

sentences.en: So, a narrow deal, perhaps announced with great fanfare.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一项狭隘的协议，也许会大张旗鼓地宣布。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: — The two countries' leaders might be able to establish a floor for the relationship here.
sentences.zh: ——两国领导人或许能够为这里的关系建立一个底线。

sentences.en: They might begin to change the trajectory so that next year they can begin to patch together something better.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会开始改变轨迹，以便明年能够开始拼凑出更好的结果。

sentences.en: Because if they don't, then we could be headed for ever greater confrontation between two superpowers with enormous ability to harm each other and the entire world.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们不这样做，那么我们可能会走向两个拥有巨大能力伤害对方和整个世界的超级大国之间更激烈的对抗。

sentences.en: — Well, Keith, thank you.
sentences.zh: ——好的，基思，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for making us all smarter in anticipation of it.
sentences.zh: 感谢你让我们在期待这一切时变得更聪明。

sentences.en: — Thank you.
sentences.zh: ——谢谢。

sentences.en: Always good to talk to you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 很高兴和你交谈，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: ——我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: ——以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: Hurricane Melissa made landfall on Tuesday, and it carved a path of destruction across Jamaica as one of the strongest Category 5 storms on record.
sentences.zh: 飓风“梅丽莎”周二登陆，作为有记录以来最强的五级风暴之一，它在牙买加造成了毁灭性的破坏。

sentences.en: It wasn't clear exactly how much damage Jamaica had sustained because of limited communications.
sentences.zh: 由于通讯受限，目前尚不清楚牙买加到底遭受了多大的损失。

sentences.en: But Jamaican officials said that 15,000 people were in government shelters.
sentences.zh: 但牙买加官员表示，有1.5万人住在政府避难所中。

sentences.en: More than half a million people, or about a sixth of the country's population, were without power.
sentences.zh: 超过50万人，即该国约六分之一的人口，处于断电状态。

sentences.en: — And on Tuesday, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the Trump administration had launched yet another round of deadly strikes on boats that it claims were smuggling drugs,
sentences.zh: ——周二，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯表示，特朗普政府对据称走私毒品的船只发动了又一轮致命打击，

sentences.en: killing 14 people in four vessels.
sentences.zh: 造成四艘船上的14人死亡。

sentences.en: Hegseth said the strikes took place in international waters and that there had been one survivor.
sentences.zh: 赫格塞斯说，袭击发生在公海，有一名幸存者。

sentences.en: — The attacks bring the overall death toll in the growing U.S.
sentences.zh: ——这些袭击使美国在中南美洲海岸外日益加剧的

sentences.en: military campaign off the Central and South American coasts to 57.
sentences.zh: 军事行动的总死亡人数达到57人。

sentences.en: Finally, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the Israeli military to conduct strikes in Gaza on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 最后，以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡周二下令以色列军队在加沙进行打击。

sentences.en: The Israeli government accused Hamas of violating the ceasefire agreement by firing on Israeli forces and failing to return the bodies of dead hostages.
sentences.zh: 以色列政府指责哈马斯向以色列军队开火并未能归还死亡人质的遗体，从而违反了停火协议。

sentences.en: Netanyahu's office said the prime minister had informed President Trump before the action was taken.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室表示，总理在采取行动前已通知了特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Hamas denied involvement in an attack on Israeli forces and, in a statement, said it remained committed to the ceasefire agreement, which had accused Israel of violating.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯否认参与了对以色列军队的袭击，并在声明中表示，它仍然致力于停火协议，并指责以色列违反了该协议。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mary Wilson and Ricky Nowetsky.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由玛丽·威尔逊和里奇·诺维茨基制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周编辑。

sentences.en: It contains original music by Dan Powell, Marion Lozano, and Pat McCusker.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔、马里昂·洛萨诺和帕特·麦卡斯克创作的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittrowak.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗瓦克。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和萨拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方收听。

sentences.en: From the Highlights.
sentences.zh: 来自《精华》。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: Let's continue.
sentences.zh: 我们继续。
